messages:
Fiona: Heads up  someone put a sushi tray in the fridge labeled 'Team lunch' but I noticed all the little soy packets have vanished. Did we go through a soy drought? :fish:
Marcus: Oops that was me grabbing one for my roll. Thought they were communal. My bad  will replace.
Jonah: Quick etiquette q: are condiment packets considered communal or attached to the meal? I was always taught to keep them with the container.
Lina: I vote "with the meal". If you bring food with condiments, label them 'for meal' or leave an extra stash. Otherwise communal = fair game.
Priya: Idea: tiny condiment jar on the counter with little labeled packets (soy, sriracha, mayo). People can top up from their deliveries. Prevents scavenging.
kitchen-bot: Action noted: add condiment caddy x1 to supplies. Suggested: small mason jar dividers + labels. ETA 3 business days. (/order-3345)
Fiona: Also a small sad discovery: someone reused a plastic chopstick pair and left it in the sink. Could we put a sign: "single-use unless washed"? 
Marcus: Sorry about that. I'll toss the used pair and buy a tub of reusable chopsticks for the kitchen.
Jonah: I can donate a pack of bamboo chopsticks and an extra soy bottle if that helps.
Lina: Love it. Another micro-idea: colored washi tape system to mark personal Tupperware. Pick a color for your name and stick a strip on the lid. Visual and cute.
Priya: YES. Also let's add a 'mug library' on the top shelf with labeled mugs for folks who forget theirs. Rules: 1) take a mug, 2) wash ASAP, 3) return or replace if it chips.
Fiona: Mug library = brilliant. We have a mug graveyard behind the kettle that could be repurposed into a 'borrow shelf'.
Marcus: Poll: preferred labeling method for Tupperware? 1) Sharpie on lid 2) Washi tape color 3) Name sticker
snackbot: Vote by replying 1/2/3.
Jonah: 2
Lina: 2
Marcus: 3
Priya: 2
Fiona: 2
kitchen-bot: Supplies queued: washi tape assorted colors x12 rolls, small waterproof name stickers x200, communal soy bottle x2. (/order-3345-confirm)
Fiona: Tiny allergy note: if you bring fish/peanut heavy dishes, please mark with icons. I have a severe fish sensitivity and could accidentally use the communal soy.
Marcus: Thanks for flagging Fiona. We'll add an 'allergy icon' line to the sticker template.
Jonah: Logistics: I'll tape a little 'mug library' sign tonight and arrange the borrow shelf tomorrow morning.
Priya: I'll make a tiny cheat-sheet for the washi colors and post it on the fridge so folks know who owns what.
Fiona: Amazing teamwork. Also if anyone sees a lone soy packet on the sink — it's mine. Replaced what I took :pray:
Marcus: Thanks Fiona. I'll bring a spare soy packet pack tomorrow too. Promise no more stealth condiment missions. :sweat_smile:
Jonah: GIF for morale: https://giphy.com/gifs/food-communal-1 (condiment peace treaty)
Lina: Closing note: if you borrow from the mug library, leave a tiny sticky with your name so we can track borrower frequency (not policing, just curiosity).
Priya: Love it. Also motion to adopt the washi tape system immediately. All in favor say :raised_hands:
All: :raised_hands: :tada:
